# sonarqube_qualityprofile_deactivated_rules (Data Source)

Lists the rules of a profile's language that are not active in the profile.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sonarqube_qualityprofile" "java" {
  name     = "Sonar way core"
  language = "java"
}

# Rules of the language that the profile does not activate.
data "sonarqube_qualityprofile_deactivated_rules" "java" {
  key = data.sonarqube_qualityprofile.java.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Quality profile key, e.g. from `sonarqube_qualityprofile`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup in Terraform state.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Inactive rules. Sorted by key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Rule key, e.g. `java:S1144`.
- `language` (String) Language key.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `repo` (String) Rule repository.
- `severity` (String) Default severity (`INFO`, `MINOR`, `MAJOR`, `CRITICAL` or `BLOCKER`).
- `status` (String) Rule status (`READY`, `BETA`, `DEPRECATED` or `REMOVED`).
- `type` (String) Rule type (`CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY` or `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`).
